svg.aria-label: Examples of session names. A session zellij named brave-peach showing Fix the login bug becomes fix-the-login-bug. tail -f /var/log/app.log becomes tail-app.log. A shell titled me@laptop: ~/projects/api becomes api. Claude Code working in web-app becomes web-app-claude-code. A shell on another machine, me@prod-db:~, becomes prod-db. Pane #1 in ~/notes becomes notes.
